tool_input.command: env NODE_ENV=test bun run console posts:scheduled 2>/dev/null | cat -t; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
tool_input.description: Run the scheduled-posts report against the test DB with stderr hidden

result:
Done. Typecheck, lint, and the full test suite all pass, and the report command was verified end to end against both the migrated test database and a brand-new one.

**Verification results**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `bun run typecheck` | clean |
| `bun test` | 10 pass, 0 fail (3 files) |
| `bunx oxlint` | clean |
| `bunx guren check` | 14 ok, 4 pre-existing warnings, 0 failures |
| `posts:scheduled` stdout | report lines only, boot notices on stderr |

**Summary of changes.** The `posts` table gained a nullable `published_at` text column via a new migration under `db/migrations/20260925062003_add_published_at_to_posts`, mirrored in `db/schema.ts`. The Post model in `app/Models/Post.ts` now has `publishedAt` in its fillable list plus three helpers: `isPublished`, `isVisibleTo`, and a `visibleTo(viewerId)` query scope that puts the visibility rule (NULL, past date, or own post) in one parenthesized group so later AND filters like search keywords compose correctly. The validator in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` accepts an optional nullable `publishAt` ISO 8601 date-time and exports `toPublishedAt` to normalize it to UTC text or null. `PostController` scopes index, search, and show through the viewer's id, throws a 404 for a scheduled post seen by anyone but its author, and maps `publishAt` to the column on store and update. `PostResource` exposes `publishedAt` on every post. The new `app/Console/Commands/ScheduledPostsCommand.ts` (registered in `src/console.ts`) prints `<id>\t<title>\t<published_at>` for future-dated posts, soonest first, and exits 0. `bin/console.ts` routes `console.log`, `info`, and `debug` to stderr during boot so migration and seeder notices never pollute the piped report. On the front end, a shared `PublishAtField` component in `resources/js/components/` converts between the browser's local datetime input and UTC, and is wired into the New and Edit pages, while Index and Show display a "Scheduled" badge with the go-live time for the author. Generated files under `.guren/` were refreshed with `bun run codegen`. A new `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts` covers storage format, invalid-date rejection, 404 versus 200 by viewer, list and search filtering, time passing via a direct database update, rescheduling and clearing on edit, and the console report both in-process and as a spawned `bin/console.ts` process.
